messages:
saneil_customer: Hey team — our trial account (org_id: org_9X2) just ran a streaming chat request and the UI shows no credit deduction. Request id: req_0ab3. Happened twice in last hour. Response was 200 and stream closed by client. Can you check why tokens not debited?

maria_cs: Sorry about that, @saneil_customer. Can you paste the raw request id + approximate timestamp? Was it HTTP streaming (chunked) or WebSocket? Any SDK vs curl?

saneil_customer: Using our frontend SDK over a websocket-like streaming connection. Timestamp ~2026-03-15T16:03:10Z. We see messages and final token count on UI but credits still same. No error returned.

maria_cs: Thanks. Escalating to billing with logs. @kevin_billing any quick checks? :eyes:

kevin_billing: Looking up req_0ab3 now. Quick note: billing ledger shows a pending session creation but no finalize entry for that session id (sess_7u4). That would leave usage unconsumed. Can you share the SDK client-side disconnect behavior? We need to know if client abruptly closed without hitting finalize.

ryan_eng: Hypothesis: if the client connection terminates early (e.g., browser tab closed) and our gateway sees an upstream 499/connection reset, the finalize hook sometimes doesn't run due to a race in the streaming worker. I can reproduce locally.

ryan_eng: Repro steps I used: 1) open streaming WS via the JS SDK; 2) send a short prompt; 3) kill the tab (ctrl+w) immediately after first chunks. On the server side you'll see the request lifecycle end with a 499 from the proxy and the session's finalize path not executing.

ryan_eng: Minimal repro (Node):
```
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.example/stream?key=***');
ws.on('open', () => { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })); setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 50); });
```
Server logs show:
```
[proxy] 10.1.2.3 - - "POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1" 499 - "-" "curl/7.x"
[worker] session sess_7u4 created
[worker] got chunks...
[worker] connection lost: upstream closed
# finalize handler not invoked due to early cancel
```

kevin_billing: That aligns with the missing finalize. If finalize doesn’t run, the billing pipeline never gets the token counts to debit. Two follow-ups: (1) can we add a short-lived fallback finalize from the gateway (best-effort) when connections close unexpectedly, (2) add a reconciliation job to convert stale open sessions > X minutes to finalized with best-effort counts.

maria_cs: For immediate mitigation, @saneil_customer can you flip a client flag to force a finalize before page unload? In our JS SDK there's an option: `finalizeOnDisconnect:true` (v1.4.2+). If you enable it the client will attempt a finalizing POST before quitting.

saneil_customer: Ok we enabled `finalizeOnDisconnect:true` and re-ran same flow. After forcing disconnect finalize the ledger shows a debit for ~42 tokens for req_0ab3-alt. :thumbsup: Any long term fix timeline?

ryan_eng: We created BUG-1124: ensure server triggers a best-effort finalize on worker side when proxy reports 499/connection reset. Patch queued for next release; temporary hotfix: gateway can emit a finalize event on close which the worker will consume. I'll push a canary later today.

kevin_billing: Also kicking off a one-off reconciliation script to sweep sessions in 'open' state older than 5m and finalize them with recorded partial counts. Will post results here.

billing-bot: Recon job started: sweep_open_sessions(older_than=5m) -> will attempt finalize. Job id job_20260315_01.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. @saneil_customer we'll monitor job_20260315_01 and confirm credits are now accurate across your org.

saneil_customer: Confirmed — after enable + recon run the balance reflects the consumed tokens. Appreciate the quick help.

ryan_eng: Root cause summary: client-side abrupt disconnect created a proxy 499 path that skipped finalize handler in the worker; missing finalize meant no debit. Next actions: hotfix for gateway finalize-on-close (today), server-side guard to run finalize in worker cleanup (next week), add reconciliation sweep (already running).

maria_cs: Closing this thread once recon job completes and you validate for 24h. Thanks :white_check_mark:
